observed: The account spec fails: after the profile page opens the browser ends up on /login, although the beforeEach mocks GET auth/me with a signed-in user. The navbar issues a background GET /api/v1/cart on every page and the spec has no mock for it. Some of the spec's intercept patterns are broad (for example '**/cart*') and the dev server reported them matching source modules served by Vite.
error:
AssertionError: Timed out retrying after 4000ms: expected 'http://localhost:5173/login' to include '/account'
(network log: GET /api/v1/cart -> 401 Unauthorized, not intercepted)
environment: Vite dev server with a React SPA; the SPA clears the session on a 401 from any API call.
